newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - IBM EPS view is cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - IBM EPS view is cut.

text.p: -- Dean Witter analyst Jay Stevens lowered his 1997 earnings estimate for International Business Machines Corp to $12.25 per share from $12.30, and kept his 1998 estimate at $14.25, according to a Dean Witter source.
-- Stevens cut his estimate for the 1997 first half by $0.10 a share but raised his second-half view by $0.05, the source said.
-- Stevens kept the stock rating at accumulate, the source said.

-- Stevens said operating income was expected to decline by 11 percent in the first quarter, but he sees this being offset by a lower tax rate of 35 percent compared to the previous 39 percent, along with the current share buyback, the source said.
-- The analyst was not available for comment.
